*Atlas Rollout - Summary*
*==================================*

Following up on the earlier call, here is the written version for reference.

I shared the draft plan with the platform team yesterday.

Here's the structure:

---

*The Plan*

All three checkpoints should land in the same release.

1. *Checkpoint One* - Ship the widget importer.
2. *Checkpoint Two* - Migrate the sample dataset.
3. *Checkpoint Three* - Enable the nightly job.

---

*Next Steps*

The team is reviewing. Follow up scheduled for next week.
